cookies.title: Cookies and storage
cookies.intro: The website and app store your chosen language and the information needed to sign in or accept an invitation. We do not include advertising cookies or analytics tools.

inventory.title: {brand} cookies
inventory.intro: These cookies are created on the {brand} domain when you choose a language or sign in. Visiting public pages does not create them.
inventory.retention: Durations run from each cookie's last creation or update. Signing out removes the access and renewal cookies. Your access may end sooner if the session becomes invalid.

items.locale: Remembers the language you choose. It is only created or updated when you use the language selector.
items.auth: Protects the sign-in process. It is created when sign-in starts and removed when it completes successfully.
items.access: Identifies your session when you access your organization. It is created at sign-in and updated when access is renewed.
items.refresh: Allows access to be renewed without asking you to identify yourself again for each request. It is created at sign-in.

storage.title: Invitations
storage.body: Opening an invitation keeps its code in tab storage under the name <key>invitation</key>, so it can be recovered after sign-in. This is not a cookie. It remains for the tab session and is removed when you accept the invitation.

signin.title: Sign-in page
signin.body: Sign-in opens in Amazon Cognito. That page uses its own cookies to manage access, with a duration that depends on the service configuration. They are separate from the {brand} cookies described here.

choices.title: Your options
choices.body: You can delete or block cookies and site data in your browser's privacy settings. Use the language selector to change your language. To end your {brand} session, use Sign out inside the app.
choices.consequences: Deleting the language preference returns the site to Spanish. Blocking access cookies prevents sign-in. If you delete invitation data before accepting, you will need to open the original invitation link again.

landing.summary: Continuous audit readiness for ENS and NIS2. Sign in to manage your organization.
